name: Create a tiny dictionary
description: Creates a saved dictionary from a text resource. Each run creates a new dictionary.

data.code:
local text = chameleon.resources.get("keys.txt")
local dictionary = chameleon.dictionaries.decode(text, "Plugin example keys")
chameleon.dictionaries.save(dictionary)
chameleon.ui.info("Saved " .. #dictionary.keys .. " example keys.")
